meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only for external windows or desktop UI that needs OS-level control, and Playwright or CDP for external pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从命令行调度开发工作区,完成智能体间的任务交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你同时跑多个开发智能体,需要在工作区、终端和任务间来回切换。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate dev worktrees and hand off tasks between agents from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple dev agents and need to switch between their worktrees, terminals, and ongoing tasks.

howto.what: Claude 会改用 orca 这条命令来操作 Orca 的工作树、终端、仓库、制品等，而不是用原始 git 或临时终端。动手前会先选出对的 orca 程序，再运行 `ORCA skills get orca-cli` 加载配套文档。
howto.when: 当用户说出 '$orca-cli'、'Orca worktree'、'handoff' 等关键词，或要求管理 Orca 工作树、终端、制品等时触发。涉及 Orca 状态时优先于原始 git 或临时终端。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 帮我处理这个 Orca 工作树
say.note: Claude 会先加载 orca 命令行指南再操作。

say.text: 在子工作树里启动 codex
say.note: 对应 child worktree / spawn 场景。

say.text: 把这个任务交接给另一个 agent
say.note: 对应 handoff 触发场景。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the `orca` CLI for Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, and artifacts instead of raw git or ad hoc PTYs. It first resolves the correct orca executable, then runs `ORCA skills get orca-cli` to load the matching guide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says '$orca-cli', 'Orca worktree', 'handoff', etc., or asks to manage Orca worktrees, terminals, or artifacts. It is preferred over raw git or temporary terminals when Orca state is involved.

say_en.text: Use orca-cli to handle this Orca worktree.
say_en.note: Claude loads the CLI guide first.

say_en.text: Spawn codex in a child worktree.
Hand this task off to another agent.
